_comment: Host-side integration test config. Copy to test_config.json and adjust; --base-url on the command line overrides base_url. Keys starting with _ are documentation only.

prompt_logprobs._comment: Prompt scoring (lm_eval loglikelihood) test. The runner enables the server-side switch itself, verifies the disabled->400 gate, and disables it again afterwards.
prompt_logprobs.prompt: The Eiffel Tower is located in the city of Paris.

switch._comment: Model hot-swap test: loads model_dir, runs a smoke completion, then loads restore_model_dir back. unload_first=true is the server default (old model freed before the new one loads) and is the reliable order; it is set explicitly here so the test does not drift if the default ever changes.

grammar._comment: Grammar-constrained decoding (docs/MANUAL.md). Grammar is fixed per model, so each kind needs its own model directory: build them on the target with 'python3 setup_grammar_models.py --base <model bundle> --out /home/root/grammar_test'. Every G0x test switches the slot itself and G08 restores restore_model_dir.

lora._comment: Set 'adapter' to a LoRA adapter name defined in the model's genie_config.json, then enabled=true.

vlm._comment: Needs a VLM_SLOTS entry on the server (see examples/config/env_config.vlm.sample.json). image_path empty = a built-in 64x64 red PNG is sent; set a real image path for a meaningful description check. 'model' routes to the VLM slot by its model directory name.
vlm.question: Describe this image in one sentence.
